scope: 18 distinct representative English queries; 20 search requests including two repeated queries to improve source coverage. Bounded qualitative research, not a comprehensive demand or rank audit.

measurement.basis: Public-query qualitative observations plus an explicitly labeled task/usefulness hypothesis.
limits: Research results are not a personalized Google Canada/US rank snapshot.
Result order, result counts and publication freshness do not establish traffic or site indexing.
Related questions below come from inspected page headings and visible question-shaped result titles; no complete People Also Ask or autocomplete inventory was captured.
A research fetch failure is not proof that a public page is broken.
No copied competitor benchmarks, tables, prose, offers or build datasets were imported.

priorityPolicy.P0: Complete a central visitor journey and prevent consequential cost, compatibility or performance misunderstandings; no traffic superiority implied.
priorityPolicy.P1: Connect an existing useful intent to a specific decision, source record and tool.
priorityPolicy.P2: Expand only after coverage, evidence, review and measured demand justify the work.

GN-BUILD.inspection: Original page inspected: parts list, component rationale, alternatives, disclosure and linked reviews. Its historical offers are not current site prices.

TS-CPU.inspection: Original CPU comparison inspected: named buying question, per-game sections, presets, test context and conclusions. No numeric results imported.

TH-VRAM.inspection: Original capacity comparison inspected: graphics-setting context, workload distinctions, price discussion and verdict. No test table imported.

TS-GPU.inspection: Original source inspected for query context: named game/resolution and raster/ray-tracing sections; it is historical test evidence, not a new site FPS measurement.

MSI-CPU.inspection: Original support procedure inspected. Exact CPU support and BIOS need the board's model-specific compatibility table; no minimum BIOS was inferred from the socket.

MSI-B650.inspection: Official model support URL opened. Extracted content did not provide the exact 9800X3D/minimum-BIOS table, which remains a verification dependency.

CORSAIR-CABLE.inspection: Original cable compatibility page inspected. Keep exact PSU/cable type checks, not a universal cable claim.

CORSAIR-4000D.inspection: Official manual appeared in results; research-tool open returned an internal error in this demand pass. Product workstream separately inspected the original exact case SKU page. A radiator-layout verdict requires the actual manual/measurement.

MSI-NO-DISPLAY.inspection: Original no-display support page inspected. Generic desktop procedure must not replace the exact motherboard/manual instructions.

EPIC-FORTNITE.inspection: Original page inspected: minimum, recommended and Epic Quality sections. No exact FPS for arbitrary components inferred.

CDPR-CP2077.inspection: Original page inspected: separate Update 2.0/Phantom Liberty and previous 1.63 requirements, rendering modes and frame-generation caveat.

TS-STORAGE.inspection: Original publisher article located through search; used only as a research lead for title/intent. Its benchmark conditions require inspection before numeric claims.

PUGET-RAM.inspection: Original article inspected: application-specific results, project settings and limits. Do not generalize one project into universal gaming or creator capacity.

INTEL-BUILD.inspection: Original beginner guide inspected: preparation, parts, assembly and setup. Brand-specific marketing is not an independent recommendation.

queries.action: Make the troubleshooting wizard a clear symptom entry and retain one complete checklist article. Reuse driver rollback guidance and explain frame intervals without a fabricated bottleneck percentage.
